shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat, ledger-aware island logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (sky-view only).
- Selection survives column view switches. Pocket maps: celestial/climate via GROUND map; fog-mesh self-heal on first view. Underground biome trial notes in pass 16.
- All levels are real maps. Viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.
- Logistics doctrine: storage priority wins; consumers fetch back per need; demand hauls residual-clamped + ledger-aware; ALL carried-cargo continuations target the LANDED thing (merge-safe).
- Needs-bridge doctrine: postfix the vanilla giver, keep any real local result, re-run the giver's own guard chain, probe linked levels virtually with the SAME vanilla finder, one-hop stairs job, giver re-fires on arrival; per-pawn fail cooldowns.

## REMOVED FEATURES (postmortems preserved)
**SKYLIGHTS (round 7)** — postmortem pass 16. **MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (round 12)** — removed per user; revisit dossier in pass 22 schematic + lore (biomes): water facts, three-signal detection, per-FACE hydrology, ExecuteLift machinery; UNSOLVED: per-stretch single-exit-face lips + braided-terrain seal.

## VERIFIED
RMB cross-level (USER) · basement (USER) · Batch A (USER) · bug-wave fixes "mostly fixed" (USER): mech charge crash gone, bill supply + mech RMB working.

## RECENT FIX HISTORY (passes 23-25)
Pass 23: Invoke(null) fix + demand fan-cap + forbidden-aware availability + mech RMB. Pass 24: ferry discipline (ledger/clamps/onward hop). Pass 25: merge-kill fix + bill-product continuation.

## NEW COMPAT BUILT (pass 31) — WVC Work Modes · Stratum · Sand & Snow Coverage
**WVC - Work Modes** (wvc.sergkart.biotech.MoreMechanoidsWorkModes) — ABWVCWorkModesCompat.cs, all-reflection, per-seam fail-open. Their givers DECLARE their own TryGiveJob (charger subclasses JobGiver_GetEnergy directly, escort subclasses JobGiver_AIFollowPawn), so our verified vanilla mech patches never bind for WVC-mode mechs. Five seams: (1) charger routing — mirrors their exact vanilla-API recharge gate (CurLevel+0.1 < GetMaxRechargeLimit−5), reuses Patch_MechCharge_CrossLevel.TryToward (made internal); (2) smart escort — followee via their SmartEscortUtility.GetAssignedPawnOnMap (comp escortTarget → overseer fallback; our IsPlayerHome column patch makes their at-home gate work below/above ground), next-hop stairs; (3) shutdown zones — null result disambiguated from "already parked" via their MechInShutdownZone (zone AND room variants, boxed MechanoidWorkType enum), probe linked levels with THEIR TryFindRandomMechShutdownZone under WithPawnAt(stair exit) — room-based shutdown stays level-local (documented); (4) scavenge zones — ConditionalAnyScavengeZone flips column-aware ONLY when a route can actually be armed (zone + resolvable stairs), giver postfix routes, plus a hardening prefix on GetScavengeWanderRoot (their code NREs via GetZone(pos).Cells when a mech wanders outside any zone); (5) combat column-awareness (USER-APPROVED) — ConditionalEnemyOnMap goes column-wide (AnyHostileActiveThreatTo on linked maps, respects their enableEnemySearching), and vanilla JobGiver_AIGotoNearestHostile gets a postfix (patched only while WVC active) gated to player mechs in seek modes {WVC_FindAndDestroy, WVC_WaitEnemy, WVC_WorkAndWaitEnemy} → stairs toward the raided level. DefendYourself/Ambush/escort modes intentionally stay local. Their live ModSettings respected (settings field reflection). Guards: Logistics (charge), Movement (escort/zones), Threats (combat).
**Stratum** (SolarWeb.Stratum) — ABStratumCompat.cs. Decompile-verified free ride: all Stratum roofs (own StratumRoofDefs + vanilla defs it makes buildable) live in the vanilla RoofGrid; every mutation funnels through RoofGrid.SetRoof → map.events.RoofChanged → our sky sync tracks builds/deconstructs/retractable-roof animation/HP collapse with no wiring. Buildable roofs isNatural=false → walkable AB_RoofSurface; smoothed mountain variants isNatural=true → stay mountain. Their roof WorkGivers ride our fail-open migration. ONE bridge: Stratum HP-tracks ALL roofs (Vanilla_Roofs patch extends vanilla defs), so the sky-level bomb punch (RoofBombPatches) now feeds RoofIntegrityGrid.TakeDamage(c, dmg, 0, null) — their per-roof threshold/armor/HP decide; 0 HP collapse calls SetRoof(null) → our cascade. Vanilla flat-40 punch kept as fallback when Stratum absent/bridge fails (one failure trips the bridge off for the session). LIMITATION: building their "thin rock"/"overhead mountain" writes vanilla NATURAL defs → sky above stays open air (no walkable rooftop) — documented, matches "it's a mountain now" semantics. DEFERRED: cross-level ingredient demand for Stratum RoofFrames; per-material rooftop art on the sky view.
**Sand & Snow Coverage** (kongkim.SandSnowCoverage) — ZERO CODE, decompile-verified: fully per-map, event-driven off vanilla snowGrid/sandGrid + Roofed(), null-guarded. Basement fully rock-roofed → no accumulation → no overlays; sky mirrors ground weather → rooftop snow/sand buildup on sky-level structures works automatically. Verify-only in session.
